newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria places four special T-bill issues.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria places four special T-bill issues.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry placed four special issues of floater coupon T-bills with a total par value of 17.676 billion levs and maturities between six and twelve weeks, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.

Bank dealers said the ministry might have issued the paper in a bid to meet part of 47 billion levs interest payments on seven-year T-bonds placed with the Bulgarian Natonal Bank (BNB) and State Savings Bank (SSB) last year.
Finance Ministry and BNB officials declined comment on whether the four issues were placed only with the BNB and the SSB on Wednesday.
The coupons of the issues equal the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity. The CIR is now set at 15 percent monthly or 180 percent annually.
Details of the issues follow. Par value is in million levs, prices are in percent of par.
Average yield to maturity 38.68 pct 48.87 pct

On May 31, 1995 the Finance Ministry placed with the BNB and two seven-year T-bond issues with a total par of 58.3 billion levs to cover debts of state-owned Economic bank and Mineralbank to the two institutions.
